cards.card_text: God says it's so Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things the Israelites consecrate in all their holy gifts.
cards.verse_text: And it will be worn on Aaron’s forehead, so that he may bear the iniquity of the holy things that the sons of Israel consecrate with regard to all their holy gifts. It shall always be on his forehead, so that they may be acceptable before the LORD.
